text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 110,525 to 99,922 before recovering slightly, so I should expect setbacks without assuming every dip needs a trade.","Doing nothing can prevent impulsive decisions, but it is not a substitute for checking that my holdings and risk level still fit my goals.","Because I rarely check my account, I should use a simple, scheduled review of my positions and cash rather than rely on frequent market watching."]}
